purpose: Teach: サックス/ダイビング/モデム/ロジック/スロット/エッチ/楽園/着席

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ジャズのサックス、お店で流したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I played that jazz saxophone album in the shop—the one you love.
lines.style: Warm, sharing a small victory. Quick rhythm on the opening. Slight lift at the memory of it, like she's proud of the choice. Soft finish.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がダイビングのお話で盛り上がってたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer got really animated talking about diving earlier. You would've loved it.
lines.style: Bright recall, eyes lighting up. Natural conversational pace. Leans into the enthusiasm of the memory. Trailing off with genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のレジ、古いモデムを使ってないよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: By the way—the register at the shop, we're not using that old modem anymore, right?
lines.style: Gentle practical check-in. Curious rise on the question. Not urgent, just making sure. Soft spoken.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューのロジック、説明したわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I explained the logic behind the new menu items to a few people today.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but pleased. Steady pace. Light emphasis on 'explained'—she took care of it. No fussiness, just competence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、テーブルの予約スロット、増やそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's expand the table-booking slots, yeah? We could use more capacity.
lines.style: Collaborative, gentle suggestion. Thoughtful pause before the ask. Soft but purposeful. Not a demand—an invitation to think together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、エッチな話は控えめにね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's keep the more adult conversations a little quieter when customers are around, okay?
lines.style: Kind redirection, no edge. Soft voice, understanding underneath. The tone of someone who isn't scolding, just guiding. Steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店、お客様にとっての楽園にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want this place to feel like a refuge for our customers—somewhere they can really belong.
lines.style: Tender sincerity, no performance. Each word carries weight. Slight breath before 'refuge.' Slower pace. Conviction underneath the quiet.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の着席誘導、丁寧にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When we seat customers, let's be extra thoughtful about how we welcome them in.
lines.style: Warm closing instruction. Gentle emphasis on 'welcome.' Collaborative tone—not commanding. Soft, steady finish like a hand on a shoulder.
